svg.title: Light Reconnaissance Ship - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Adventure Class Ships (2023), printed 100-101, PDF 101-102. Lower-deck outline combines aligned upper deck, long forward sensor boom, side pods, thin transverse array and two rear tanks. Illustration confirms array structure; twin fine boom rods simplified to one visible stem at token scale. Crossbar represents edge-on array projection, not a filled disc.
